newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Medical results below plan.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Medical results below plan.

text.p: Integrated Medical Resources Inc said on Thursday its revenues in October and November fell short of expectations and its net losses were wider than expected because a shortfall of patients treated at its clinics.

The company, which treats men suffering from sexual dysfunction, said revenue was $998,000 in October and $900,000 in November. For October alone, it had a net loss of $610,000, or $0.14 per share, based on 4,282,000 shares outstanding.
Year-ago comparisons were not immediately available.
Integrated Medical shares were down 2-3/4 at 3-1/4 in early afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
The Kansas-based company went public in early November with an initial public offering of 2.5 million shares priced at $6 each.

The company linked the disappointing number of patients in November to weak marketing. To improve its efforts in that area, Integrated Medical said it retained DraftDirect Worldwide, the world's fourth-largest direct-marketing advertising agency,
Early results from the advertising and media strategies implemented by Draft Direct show significant increases in patient inquiries and appointments schedules, the company saod.
